title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening Legal Theoretical Research of People's Courts in the New Era
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Strengthening Legal Theory Research in People's Courts in the New Era

Fa Fa [2024] No. 2

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, implement the Opinions on Strengthening Legal Education and Legal Theory Research in the New Era issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, promote high-quality justice with high-quality research, and support and serve Chinese-style modernization with the modernization of adjudicative work, these opinions are hereby formulated for strengthening legal theory research in people's courts in the new era.

1. General Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology. Always uphold the absolute leadership of the Party over judicial work and legal theory research, adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, earnestly study and implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, persistently use Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law to guide legal theory research in people's courts, deeply understand the decisive significance of the "two establishments," enhance the "four consciousnesses," strengthen the "four confidences," and achieve the "two safeguards," unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, vigorously strengthen research on socialist rule of law theory with Chinese characteristics, effectively improve the overall capacity and level of legal theory research in people's courts, promote the high-quality development of people's court work, and advance the historical process of comprehensively governing the country by law.

(2) Historical Mission. Based on the new situation, new tasks, and new requirements, closely focus on the theme of "justice and efficiency" and the goal of "striving to let the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," focus on the overall work of the Party and the state, focus on the prominent issues that the people are anxious and concerned about, focus on the issues of law application urgently needing resolution in judicial adjudication, further deepen research on Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, deepen research on excellent traditional Chinese legal culture, deepen research on basic theory, deepen research on the modernization of adjudicative concepts, adjudicative mechanisms, adjudicative systems, and adjudicative management, deepen research on adjudicative practice and unified application of law, deepen research on judicial issues in key areas, emerging areas, and foreign-related areas, construct a judicial theory system and discourse system that embodies socialist nature and has distinct Chinese characteristics, practical characteristics, and characteristics of the times, to achieve the theme of "justice and efficiency," to serve the overall situation and justice for the people, and to provide solid theoretical support for supporting and serving Chinese-style modernization with the modernization of adjudicative work.

(3) Basic Principles. Adhere to taking Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law as the fundamental guideline, integrate Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law as the "outline" and "soul" into the entire process and all aspects of legal theory research in people's courts, ensuring that legal theory research in people's courts always maintains the correct political direction. Adhere to the people-centered approach, focus on conducting research on prominent issues that the people care about and strongly reflect on, promoting the implementation of the "like I am in litigation" concept in judicial adjudication. Adhere to "viewing from the political perspective, handling from the rule of law perspective," focus on the political perspective, always regard emphasizing politics and considering the overall situation as a fundamental requirement, promoting the strengthening of the Party's ruling foundation; focus on the rule of law perspective, insist on using rule of law thinking and methods to conduct research and solve problems. Adhere to the theme of "justice and efficiency," study and solve major theoretical and practical problems affecting the quality and efficiency of trial and enforcement from a higher standpoint, broader perspective, and deeper level, promote judicial fairness, and improve judicial credibility. Adhere to the problem-oriented approach, take problems as the starting point of legal theory research, focus the research efforts on solving the most prominent contradictions and problems, take resolving contradictions and solving difficulties as the breakthrough point to open up the work situation, achieve targeted measures and appropriate prescriptions. Adhere to the mutual promotion of theoretical research and adjudicative practice, application requires theoretical guidance, theory should deepen towards application, through the method of "discovering problems through judicial practice, providing ideas through theoretical research, and guiding practice with academic achievements," achieve the common development and innovative development of theoretical research and judicial practice. Adhere to combining legal theory research in people's courts with the specific reality of China's rule of law construction and with excellent traditional Chinese legal culture, always maintain firm confidence in the rule of law, deeply summarize the experience and practical laws of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, form a discourse system of Chinese justice, and at the same time adhere to taking ourselves as the mainstay, absorbing beneficial achievements of world legal civilization, strive to build a higher level of socialist judicial civilization with Chinese characteristics, and make positive contributions to the development of human legal civilization.

2. Research Priorities

(4) Deepen Research on Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law. Targeting problems such as superficial and unsystematic study of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, insufficient internalization and transformation, and disconnection between learning and application, conduct in-depth research on the major original contributions and principled innovations of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, summarize and refine the concepts, viewpoints, and theories of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics that are subjective, original, and iconic, promote the scientific interpretation, academic expression, and systematic construction of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law; conduct in-depth research on how to use the worldview and methodology contained in Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and the positions, viewpoints, and methods running through it to guide trial and enforcement work, promote better service for the overall situation and justice for the people; conduct in-depth research on how to adhere to the guiding position of Marxism in the field of judicial ideology, resolutely oppose and reject Western erroneous views such as "constitutionalism," "separation of three powers," and "judicial independence," ensure clear-cut stance and firm position on principled issues and major issues of right and wrong.

(5) Deepen Research on Excellent Traditional Chinese Legal Culture. Targeting problems such as insufficient creative transformation and insufficient innovative development of excellent traditional legal culture, strengthen research on the Chinese legal system, inherit and promote the excellent ideas and concepts of the Chinese legal system, study the legal traditions and gains and losses of ancient China, excavate the essence of traditional legal culture such as people as the foundation of the state, combination of rites and law, no litigation under heaven, harmony as most precious, bright virtue and cautious punishment, and enforcement of law as firm as a mountain, deeply analyze the mechanism of action, contemporary value, and world contribution of excellent traditional Chinese legal culture, provide theoretical support, cultural resources, and innovative elements for the modernization of adjudicative work; strengthen research on the rule of law factors of red culture, deeply study and interpret the legal system construction during the New Democratic Revolution period, especially the revolutionary base areas, and the historical origin, development context, and basic trend of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, inherit and continue the red rule of law bloodline; strengthen research on modern rule of law civilization of the Chinese nation, focusing on the overall goal of building a socialist rule of law system with Chinese characteristics and building a socialist country under the rule of law, deeply study and interpret the modernization characteristics, national traits, and new era features of modern rule of law civilization of the Chinese nation, unswervingly follow the path of Chinese-style modernization rule of law; strengthen research on the inheritance and development of the "Fengqiao experience" in the new era, focus on the creation of "Fengqiao-style people's tribunals" and other work, improve the level of rule of law in the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes and the effectiveness of social governance.

(6) Deepen Research on Basic Theory. Targeting problems such as shallow basic theory research and insufficient theoretical supply, strengthen research on the basic principles of Marxist jurisprudence, focusing on the sinicization and modernization of Marxism, strengthen the refinement and interpretation of legal theory, continuously improve the Marxist rule of law theory system and the socialist rule of law theory system with Chinese characteristics, ensure that theoretical research is rooted in Chinese culture, based on China's national conditions, and solves China's problems; strengthen research on China's modern judicial system, deeply interpret the superiority of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, consciously adhere to the absolute leadership of the Party in judicial adjudication work, accelerate the construction of a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics; strengthen research on the nature and operation law of judicial power, systematically study and interpret the scientific connotation of "independently and impartially exercising adjudicative power according to law," promote the construction of a new mechanism for the operation of judicial power that is scientific, reasonable, standardized, orderly, and consistent with powers and responsibilities; strengthen basic theoretical research on major practical issues such as the functional positioning of trial levels and the construction of diversified dispute resolution mechanisms, launch a batch of high-quality and original legal theory research results.

(7) Deepen Research on Adjudicative Concepts. Targeting problems such as mechanical justice and handling cases only by the case, strengthen research on the concept of active justice in the new era, identify the functional positioning of judicial adjudication in comprehensively governing the country by law, in national governance and social governance, promote the construction of a theoretical system of active justice in the new era, promote the transformation of active justice from value concept to work system and governance mechanism, effectively lead the modernization of adjudicative work with the modernization of adjudicative concepts, support and serve Chinese-style modernization. Targeting problems such as high operation of litigation cases, empty procedure cycles, one case concluding but multiple cases arising, strengthen research on the concept of "grasping the front end, curing the disease before it occurs," insist on putting non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms first, extend the "mediation" of litigation-mediation connection forward, fulfill the function of guiding mediation, construct a large mediation work pattern based on people's mediation with linkage and connection of various types of mediation; strengthen research on source governance, deeply study major practical issues such as how to govern litigation sources, how to control enforcement sources, how to reduce petition sources, and how to manage case sources, promote the realization of "handling one case, governing one area," prevent and reduce the high incidence of similar cases from the source, promote systematic governance, comprehensive governance, and source governance as a whole; strengthen research on the concept of equal emphasis on punishment and governance, implement the criminal policy of combining leniency and severity, strengthen the application of the system of leniency for pleading guilty and accepting punishment and the reform of enterprise compliance, effectively realize the institutional functions of reducing litigation burden, resolving conflicts, and repairing social relations; strengthen research on the concept of win-win, multi-win, and all-win, implement "supervision is support, support is supervision" in administrative litigation, strengthen government-court linkage and internal and external coordination, promote the government to strengthen source governance; strengthen research on the concept of case conclusion, matter resolved, politics smooth, and people harmonious, take substantive resolution of conflicts and fundamental solution of problems as the goal orientation of judicial adjudication, maximize the realization of conflicts not being escalated, problems not being spread, and disputes not increasing.

(8) Deepen Research on Adjudicative Mechanisms. Targeting problems such as inadequate implementation of judicial responsibility, "excessive sinking, insufficient raising" of higher courts, and insufficient supervision and guidance of lower courts, strengthen research on issues such as the adjudication responsibility of single judges and collegial panels, and the supervision and management responsibilities of court presidents, division heads, and adjudication committees, improve the operation mechanisms of single-judge trials, collegial panels, professional judge meetings, and adjudication committees, ensure that the operation of adjudicative power conforms to judicial laws; strengthen research and interpretation of the reading and verification system, conduct in-depth discussions on how court presidents and division heads read and verify, further凝聚 consensus, ensure implementation, and strengthen guidance; strengthen research on the working mechanisms of upgrading jurisdiction and retrial upgrading, issue relevant judicial policies, maximize the role of higher courts in guiding and standardizing adjudication through upgrading jurisdiction; strengthen research on how to implement and refine the supervision and guidance responsibilities of higher courts, especially the Supreme People's Court and high people's courts, optimize the upper and lower linkage mechanism in the trial of appeals and retrial cases, deepen case analysis, promote the continuous improvement of the quality and efficiency of first and second instance judgments; strengthen research on the circuit trial mechanism, ensure that circuit trial work is standardized, orderly, fair, and efficient, truly play the role of facilitating the people to resolve disputes on the spot.

(9) Deepen Research on Adjudicative Systems. Targeting problems such as non-standard institutional settings, insufficient optimization of functional allocation, and inadequate big data support, strengthen research on organizational structure settings, follow the principles of simplicity, unity, and efficiency, further optimize the internal institutional settings of people's courts; strengthen research on specialized courts and specialized tribunals, comprehensively summarize and evaluate the operation status and effects of specialized courts, coordinate research on the establishment procedures, planning and layout, jurisdiction scope, and同级 legal supervision mechanisms of specialized courts, standardize the operation and management of specialized tribunals; strengthen research on the functional positioning and scope of duties of circuit tribunals, further standardize the relationship with the Supreme People's Court headquarters and with local courts; strengthen research on the integration of adjudicative functions and collaborative performance, continue to promote the "three-in-one" reform of criminal, civil, and administrative adjudication in the fields of intellectual property adjudication, juvenile adjudication, environmental resource adjudication, and maritime adjudication, improve the system and mechanism; strengthen research on the construction, management, and application of judicial big data, build and use the judicial big database well, build a nationwide court "one network," lay a solid data foundation, innovate in-depth applications, break data barriers, and give full play to the role of big data in improving the quality and efficiency of judicial adjudication and enhancing the effectiveness of litigation source governance.

(10) Deepen Research on Adjudicative Management. Targeting problems such as incomplete trial quality management indicator system and insufficient play of the assessment baton role, strengthen research on the construction and improvement of the trial quality management indicator system, pay attention to the overall quality and efficiency of cases in the jurisdiction, take the organic unity of trial quality, efficiency, and effect as the guide, focus on indicators reflecting the people's sense of judicial gain such as "case-piece ratio," case-petition ratio, rate of accepting judgment and withdrawing appeal, appeal rate, retrial application rate, and case conclusion rate within the statutory trial period, construct a trial quality and efficiency management system that conforms to judicial laws, is systematic and complete, and practical and effective; strengthen research on the full performance assessment of all personnel, correctly handle the relationship between the lawful exercise of power by adjudicative organizations and the supervision and management of court presidents and division heads, improve the assessment mechanism for court presidents and division heads handling cases, implement the dynamic management of judge posts, and promote the integration of case evaluation and personnel assessment; strengthen research on the analysis of judicial adjudication data, strengthen the overall control of the trial situation, timely solve directional, frequent, and trending problems in trial work, strengthen the work of comprehensive governance-type judicial suggestions in a targeted manner, implement the working mechanism of the Supreme People's Court consulting every quarter, high people's courts consulting every two months, and intermediate people's courts and basic people's courts consulting every month.

(11) Deepen Research on Adjudicative Practice. In criminal adjudication, focus on how to implement the overall national security concept and serve the construction of a higher level of平安 China, how to build a new pattern of criminal proceedings with trial as the center, court trial as the center, and evidence as the center, and how to further adjust and optimize criminal adjudication concepts. In civil and commercial adjudication, focus on how to strengthen the supply of judicial policies and measures, optimize the market-oriented, law-based, and internationalized business environment, promote the growth and strengthening of the private economy, prevent and resolve financial risks, promote scientific and technological innovation, maintain fair market competition, serve coordinated regional development, strengthen judicial protection of people's livelihood, how to improve the scope of environmental resource adjudication cases, serve the construction of a beautiful China through environmental resource adjudication, and how to deepen the reform of the appellate review mechanism for intellectual property cases at the national level and strengthen the construction of a specialized intellectual property adjudication system. In administrative adjudication, focus on how to coordinate the relationship between decentralization and centralization of case jurisdiction, strengthen the design and mechanism construction of level jurisdiction, territorial jurisdiction, and retrial application system for administrative cases, how to give full play to the functional role of administrative adjudication, solve the problems of high appeal rate and high retrial application rate in administrative adjudication through substantial resolution of administrative disputes, how to construct a connection work system between administrative reconsideration and administrative litigation, and transmit new concepts and adjudication standards of administrative adjudication forward to administrative reconsideration and administrative enforcement links. In state compensation adjudication, focus on how to solve the problem of large gap between the scope, principles, and standards of state compensation and the current level of economic and social development and expectations of all sectors through the amendment of the State Compensation Law, how to distinguish and straighten out the relationship between state compensation and state compensation, and how to construct the judicial relief work with equal emphasis on "immediate relief" and "long-term assistance." In enforcement work, focus on how to improve the long-term mechanism for comprehensive governance of enforcement difficulties, how to deeply carry out the governance of enforcement sources in the new era, how to promote the integration of enforcement and bankruptcy, resolve accumulated enforcement cases as soon as possible, and deepen the separation of trial and enforcement, promote the legislation on compulsory enforcement.

(12) Deepen Research on Unified Application of Law. Strengthen research on the practical guidance of unified application of law, deeply study the Chinese-style case guidance system, strengthen the overall management of cases, build and use the People's Court Case Database well, continuously improve the China Judgments Online, give full play to the functional role of typical cases in unifying adjudication rules, guiding judges in handling cases, disseminating values, and promoting social governance, provide better and more practical high-quality and efficient services for judicial adjudication, and serve the public in learning law, experts and scholars in scientific research, and lawyers in handling cases. Improve and strengthen Q&A platforms such as "Fada Network," form a system for solving legal application issues that is connected from top to bottom, standardized and efficient. Strengthen research on the unified application of law system, further standardize and improve the work of judicial interpretation, guide local courts to refine and clarify the work responsibilities and linkage mechanisms of adjudicative organizations, court presidents, division heads, and specialized departments in charge of adjudicative management, promote the formation of a multi-level, three-dimensional, and standardized unified application of law work system. Strengthen research on the unified application of law procedures, give full play to the respective institutional functions of adjudicative management, trial level system, and trial supervision procedures in unifying the application of law, improve the problem discovery mechanism in procedural links such as revision and remand for retrial, and give play to the role of trial supervision procedures in correcting errors according to law.

(13) Deepen Research on Judicial Issues in Emerging Fields. Strengthen research on issues such as the protection of people's livelihood rights and interests in the digital economy, and the governance of network platforms, promote the legislative process in the field of digital economy, and promote the modernization of the digital economy governance system and governance capacity. Strengthen research on the judicial regulation of new types of unfair competition in the network such as click farming, fake transactions, and online reviews, refine the adjudication rules for competition cases, and guide the private economy to develop in the direction of openness, innovation, and enabling. Strengthen research on the legal regulation of new technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, and facial recognition, prevent and resolve security risks in the application of new technologies, and promote the deep integration of new technologies with judicial adjudication work. Strengthen research on the judicial protection of intellectual property rights for frontier technologies closely related to scientific and technological innovation such as data and algorithms, as well as business methods and cultural creations, explore the establishment of special procedural legal systems that conform to the laws of intellectual property adjudication. Strengthen research on the legal supply in new technologies, new business forms, and new application fields, identify the combination points, entry points, and focus points of judicial adjudication and cultivating new productive forces, continuously optimize the legal environment for strategic emerging industries and future industries such as new energy, new materials, advanced manufacturing, and electronic information, and prospectively study the judicial response measures after the comprehensive abolition of foreign investment access restrictions in the manufacturing sector.

(14) Deepening Research on Foreign-Related Rule of Law. Strengthen research on foreign-related legal systems, adhere to a coordinated approach to land and maritime affairs, and conduct in-depth research on major issues concerning national security, economic development, social stability, and public peace. Actively participate in the formulation of international rules, leverage the important role of judicial cases with significant international influence in shaping international rules and filling gaps in international law, and actively articulate foreign-related rule of law concepts, propositions, and successful practices with Chinese characteristics, with a view to constructing a foreign-related legal system that is Chinese in character, connects China with the rest of the world, and is adapted to the high-level opening up under the Belt and Road Initiative. Strengthen the study and application of international law, conducting research on issues such as jurisdiction and parallel proceedings, foreign state immunity, application of international treaties, international investment arbitration, cross-border insolvency, sanctions and counter-sanctions, make good use of both domestic and international rules, accurately apply international treaties, international customs, and the applicable law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties equally in accordance with the law, and enhance the credibility of foreign-related judicial work. Strengthen research on issues concerning the application of foreign-related law, innovate mechanisms for foreign-related service of process, extraterritorial evidence collection, extraterritorial enforcement, and ascertainment of foreign law, advance the construction of platforms for ascertaining foreign law and international treaties, reinforce the implementation of the revised foreign-related chapter of the Civil Procedure Law, and improve mechanisms for countering sanctions, interference, and long-arm jurisdiction. Strengthen research on mechanisms for resolving foreign-related commercial disputes, promote the high-quality development of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court, give full play to the role of the International Commercial Expert Committee, further deepen the construction of a "one-stop" international commercial dispute resolution mechanism that integrates litigation, arbitration, and mediation in a coherent manner, and advance the pilot program for building an international commercial arbitration center. Strengthen research on the integration of foreign-related adjudication and Internet justice, improve mechanisms for online case filing, online mediation, and online court hearings in foreign-related cases, and enhance the application of technologies such as big data, blockchain, artificial intelligence, and 5G to facilitate litigation for both Chinese and foreign parties.

III. Guarantee Mechanisms

(15) Strengthening Organizational Leadership. The primary responsibility for theoretical research in people's courts law lies with the Party leadership groups of people's courts at all levels. Legal theoretical research should be treated as a foundational and strategic endeavor, to be planned, implemented, and supervised together with judicial adjudication. With respect to major theoretical and practical issues concerning the long-term development of the people's courts, leaders at all levels of the people's courts should lead by example, take the initiative to spearhead research, and use the "key minority" to drive the "overwhelming majority". Strengthen the supply of research resources, platforms, and opportunities, guide judges to actively participate in project applications, case discussions, and the drafting of normative documents, strive to become expert judges in legal theoretical research, and accelerate the cultivation of a contingent of high-quality research talents. Actively seek support from financial departments, incorporate funding for legal theoretical research into the budget, and include expenses for research projects, books and materials, and awards for legal research within the scope of operational expenditures, continuously increasing research investment.

(16) Strengthening Coordination and Linkage. Adhere to the combination of full-time and part-time personnel with full participation, with specialized research institutions and investigation institutions of the four levels of courts nationwide playing an organizational and coordinating role, and relevant functional departments and frontline trial and enforcement personnel serving as the main research subjects, to promote the formation of a new pattern of legal theoretical research in which the vast number of judicial officers in the four levels of courts nationwide participate. Adhere to top-down coherence and integrated advancement, promote the connection, communication, and integration of theoretical research lines across the four levels of courts, strengthen the echelon training of trial business experts, focus on mobilizing the initiative of trial business experts at all levels in legal theoretical research and case application research, and give full play to the role of trial business experts. Adhere to the combination of internal and external resources with mutual complementarity and interaction, establish closer ties and exchanges with universities and colleges, research institutes, high-end think tanks, journals and magazines, experts and scholars, make good use of external brains and forces, gather research resources from various fields and disciplines, explore mechanisms for social forces to support legal theoretical research, and promote the coordinated progress of independent research and commissioned research.

(17) Strengthening Investigation and Research. Adhere to a goal-oriented approach, focus on enhancing the precision of serving decision-making, treat investigation and research as a necessary link and prerequisite procedure for identifying problems and promoting work, and as a basic method of legal theoretical research, effectively through investigation and research to ascertain the situation, pinpoint problems, and propose practical countermeasures, providing forward-looking, strategic, and early-warning support for the scientific decision-making of the Party leadership group. Adhere to a problem-oriented approach, dare to face problems squarely, be adept at discovering problems, and have the courage to solve problems, promote the establishment of an annual major topic investigation system for people's courts at all levels, consolidate organizational leadership responsibilities, strengthen the full-cycle management of research projects, and ensure "genuine problem-solving and solving genuine problems". Adhere to an innovation-oriented approach, make full use of modern information technology means, conduct interdisciplinary, multi-perspective, and information-based collaborative research, and enhance the ideological weight, countermeasure quality, and value content of research outcomes.

(18) Strengthening the Transformation of Outcomes. Adhere to the principle of research for application, place the transformation and application of legal theoretical research outcomes in a prominent position, and continuously improve the ability and level of serving the overall work, serving the decision-making of the Party leadership group, and serving judicial adjudication. Establish and improve a diversified and comprehensive mechanism for the transformation of outcomes, broaden the channels for outcome transformation, promote the transformation of various research outcomes into serving Party leadership group decision-making and guiding judges in handling cases, into the formulation of judicial interpretations, judicial policies, and adjudication rules, and into legislative proposals and judicial recommendations, thus breaking through the "last kilometer" between theoretical research and practical application. Strengthen the dissemination and promotion of outstanding legal research outcomes, enhancing their practical value and their power of transmission and influence. Strengthen research on judicial external publicity work, promote international academic exchanges and cooperation, encourage experts and scholars to speak out internationally, tell the story of China's rule of law well, and enhance the international influence and discursive power of the socialist legal system and legal theory with Chinese characteristics.

(19) Strengthening Platform Construction. Give full play to the platform advantages of academic groups such as the China Judicial Research Association and its branches, the Trial Theory Research Committee of the China Law Society and its specialized committees. Attach great importance to, properly establish, manage, and make good use of research bases and research centers jointly established with universities, break down information barriers, deepen exchanges and cooperation, leverage respective advantages, form strong synergy, and produce more high-quality research outcomes. Run the court system journals well, build high-quality platforms for the exchange of research outcomes, and promote a positive interaction between theoretical research and trial practice. Relying on the China Institute of Applied Law, advance the construction of a high-end rule of law think tank, strengthen front-end reserve research, mid-end countermeasure research, and back-end follow-up research, showcase, publish, and promote constructive research outcomes of courts at various levels, and fulfill the think tank functions of providing policy advice, theoretical innovation, public opinion guidance, social services, and public diplomacy. Explore the establishment of a national network information platform for legal theoretical research resources in people's courts, promote the integration of resources, and achieve system integration, resource sharing, and outcome sharing.

(20) Strengthening Evaluation and Incentives. Improve the evaluation methods for legal theoretical research, take the service of research outcomes to Party leadership group decision-making, guidance of judicial practice, and promotion of work as the main measurement criteria, promote the transformation of theoretical research from emphasizing quantity and process to emphasizing quality and results, and implement performance-based classification evaluation. For cases handled that are selected into the People's Court Case Database or research outcomes that achieve transformation and application, they shall be taken as bonus points in performance appraisal and reflected in promotions, job rank advancements, and evaluations for awards and honors. Explore the establishment of an annual performance notification system for legal theoretical research work, with the Supreme People's Court preparing a "Theoretical Research Performance Analysis Report" on the research outcomes and their transformation of courts at various levels, to be notified within the national court system. Establish and improve the selection and reward system for outstanding legal research outcomes of people's courts, to create a better atmosphere for theoretical research. Advance research on the evaluation of applied law outcomes in the new era, introduce evaluation indicators that reflect the influence of legal research outcomes on legislation and the advancement of judicial practice, and scientifically assess the contribution of applied law research outcomes to the development of rule of law practice.
